description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class 'Coocook::Controller::Ajax::IngredientsEditor' for handling AJAX requests related to ingredients editing in a cooking project. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, moving, deleting, and creating ingredients, as well as fetching articles and units, with access control via capabilities.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Ajax::IngredientsEditor
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for AJAX ingredient editing operations.

methods.name: project_base
methods.description: Chained method to set up project context based on dish or recipe ID, with access control.

methods.name: get_all_ingredients
methods.description: Retrieves all ingredients for the current dish or recipe, formatted for the ingredients editor.

methods.name: update_ingredient
methods.description: Updates an existing ingredient's details in the database.

methods.name: prepend_ingredient
methods.description: Moves an ingredient to the beginning of its group, with optional preparation status.

methods.name: append_ingredient
methods.description: Appends an ingredient to the end of its group, with optional preparation status.

methods.name: move_ingredient
methods.description: Moves an ingredient up or down within its group.

methods.name: delete_ingredient
methods.description: Deletes an ingredient from the database.

methods.name: all_articles
methods.description: Fetches all articles associated with the project.

methods.name: all_units
methods.description: Fetches all units associated with the project.

methods.name: add_ingredient
methods.description: Creates a new ingredient, possibly creating related article and unit entries.
